meta.title: The 100-Reviewer Panel

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.desc: Information hierarchy, H1 scale, above-the-fold comprehension in <2s, KPI/verdict legibility.

criteria.label: Distinctness
criteria.desc: Unique geometry and narrative vs siblings; anti-drift / not an identical skin.

criteria.label: Accessibility
criteria.desc: Keyboard paths, ARIA, focus management, reduced motion, AA contrast, skip links, live regions.

criteria.label: Responsive
criteria.desc: 360/390/768/1024/1440 reflow, mobile card fallback, sticky behaviour, no horizontal scroll.

criteria.label: Performance
criteria.desc: Page weight, inline script size, zero external requests, zero image payload.

criteria.label: Interaction
criteria.desc: Real working interactions: command palette, sort, tab keyboard model, file-preview dialog, stepper, keyboard tiles, 1-6 tab keys, forms.

criteria.label: State coverage
criteria.desc: Populated, empty (incl. captured in-tab empties), loading/skeleton, 502 error + retry + status banner.

criteria.label: Guidance
criteria.desc: Verdict lines, why-locked / unlock explainers, Help-FAQ, Ask-AI, inline validation, honest 'nothing due' cues.

criteria.label: Honesty
criteria.desc: No invented rows/rates/APIs; demo-labelled CTAs; frozen-content fidelity; audit-truthful copy.

criteria.label: Consistency
criteria.desc: One token scheme, light/dark parity, brand discipline, semantic HTML, reduced-motion parity.

meta.method: Deterministic seeded simulation of 100 distinct personas; NOT real human research.
meta.limits: Criterion ratings come from static code analysis + documented design facts. No screenshot/browser/real-user testing was performed.
meta.supersedes: Study 1 · F05 + F06 (same 100 personas, same seed)
